name: The Worthy Bride
source:
Jane Whitman arrives to Woodhouse estate to celebrate announcement of engagement between Ashton Woodhouse and Miss Chaterel. She is waiting for approval with Frederick Woodhouse herself. This meeting becomes a place for detective mystery to unfold.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
简·惠特曼来到伍德豪斯庄园，参加阿什顿·伍德豪斯与查特雷尔小姐的订婚发布会。她自己也在等待弗雷德里克·伍德豪斯的认可。这场聚会很快成为一桩侦探谜案展开的舞台。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
